depicts: Web map app view: world map with many overlapping blue straight lines crossing continents, a 'Find Place' search bar, and a trip file row named wwbrews.json with a distance badge.
text_readable: Readable: 'Find Place', 'wwbrews.json', '636,462 mi', 'Leaflet | © OpenStreetMap contributors'. Small toolbar icons have no readable text.
composition: Map fills upper three quarters; blue line tangle concentrated around Europe/Africa; controls strip and file row along the bottom; lines run off the left and right edges.
tone_and_contrast: Pale beige/light-blue map with saturated blue lines; lines stand out clearly against the light map; bottom panel white with dark green buttons.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Crisp UI text and lines; slight aliasing on line edges; Leaflet zoom buttons and attribution visible in frame; no watermark.
scan_first_read: A world map covered in tangled blue lines, a very large mileage number below it.
